title: fix(rest, runtime): serve pending metadata drafts only to a caller with an authoring capability
body:
Fixes #20338
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

A pending metadata draft is unpublished authoring work. Before this PR, only `GET /meta/_drafts` gated it: that door answers 403 to a caller without an authoring capability. Every other door that asks the protocol for draft content served it to any signed-in caller who could open the item. Now every such door asks the same predicate first, `isObjectSchemaMaskExempt` (a system context, or `studio.access`, `setup.access` or `manage_metadata`). This is not a second rule.

| Door | Caller without the capability, before | Caller without the capability, after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| REST `GET /meta/:type/:name?state=draft` | 200, the pending draft row (pruned per caller) | the plain read's answer, byte for byte: the published item, or 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` for a never-published item (never `NO_DRAFT`) |
| REST `GET /meta/:type/:name?preview=draft` | 200, the draft overlaid on the active item | the plain read's answer, byte for byte |
| REST `GET /meta/:type?preview=draft` | the draft overlay, with draft-only items listed | the plain list, byte for byte (the `api` served-set filter applies again) |
| REST `POST /analytics/dataset/query` with `previewDrafts: true` or `?preview=draft` | the draft dataset definition, and the pending seed draft's rows | the published dataset over live rows; a draft-only `datasetName` gets the door's own 404 `NOT_FOUND` |
| dispatcher `GET /meta/:type/:name?preview=draft` | the draft overlay | the dispatcher's plain read, byte for byte (404 for a never-published item) |
| dispatcher `GET /meta/:type?preview=draft` | the draft overlay | the dispatcher's plain list, byte for byte |
| REST and dispatcher `GET /meta/_drafts` | 403 | 403 (unchanged; it now calls the same helper) |

**Why a fallback and not a 403.** Triage `5861173247` set the direction: 「A member without it reads the published version, or 404 for an app with no published version」. The shape matches what `?preview=draft` already does when no draft exists, since the protocol degrades to the published value. It also makes the answer independent of whether a draft exists: it is identical to a read that never named the switch, so it is not an oracle, and it tells the caller nothing about pending work. `/meta/_drafts` keeps its 403 because it lists drafts only and has no published answer to fall back to.

**Builders are unchanged.** A caller with the capability reads exactly what they read before on every door. On `?state=draft`, whoever may save the app reads it whole (the ruling of `5861438413`), and everyone else who may read drafts reads it pruned per caller. Each door carries that control in the tests.

**The mechanism.**
- `rest-server.ts` has one module-level `mayReadPendingDrafts(caller)`, a bare delegation to `isObjectSchemaMaskExempt`. The runtime dispatcher has its own identical delegation in `domains/meta.ts`, which its `_drafts` door and both preview doors ask. That keeps `@objectstack/rest` free of a new export for a one-liner, and both delegations reach the one `@objectstack/metadata-core` predicate.
- Every draft switch is declared together with its admission (`const previewDrafts = … && mayReadPendingDrafts(ctx)`), so no later branch can read the switch past the gate.
- The item read used to parse `?state=` a second time in its uncached arm (`stateParam`). That re-derivation is gone: the request literal and the read policy both read the admitted `isDraftRead`. `readCtx` is now resolved above the two switches (memoised per request, not a new seam).
- **For #20320's claimant:** the `GET /meta/:type` list door's gate is a single declaration at its entry. `previewDrafts` is now declared right after `listCtx` and `listOrganizationId`, before `listRequest`, and carries its admission. If you move the list handler's projections, keep that declaration ahead of every read of `previewDrafts`.

## Tests

The fix was committed first (`8bc02e48b`). Pre-fix readings were taken at `149bf8a50`, where the tests were committed and the fix was not.

- **New `packages/rest/src/meta-draft-read-builder-gate.test.ts`, real stack** (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`, real `sys_metadata*`, real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, real routes). Per door: a member reads the published version; a member gets the absence answer for a draft-only item; every builder (Studio, Setup, `manage_metadata`) reads the draft (the control). It also pins that a member's `?state=draft` on an item with no draft is the published read, never `NO_DRAFT`, and one cross-door predicate cell: each caller is refused by `/meta/_drafts` exactly when the item, list and dataset doors serve them the published version.
  - Pre-fix: 15 member cells red, 6 builder controls green.
  - Post-fix: 21/21.
- **New `packages/rest/src/meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts`.** An AST census of every draft switch in `rest-server.ts`, keyed `route » text`. Each switch is ledgered as `read`, `listing` or `write`. A `read` must carry its admission in its own declaration, the `listing` must sit behind `if (!mayReadPendingDrafts(…))`, and the helper must stay a bare delegation. A new draft door reddens it.
- **New `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-draft-read-builder-gate.test.ts`.** The dispatcher's item and list doors: member cells, draft-only 404, builder controls, a protocol-handed-the-switch assertion, and two-transport parity (for 5 callers, the dispatcher's `_drafts` admission, its preview answers and `RestServer`'s item answer agree). It also carries the same AST census over `domains/meta.ts`.
  - Pre-fix: 7 red, 6 green.
  - Post-fix: 13/13.
- **Existing pins moved, not weakened.**
  - The #20156 census gained a declared `readsDrafts` caller property, checked against `/meta/_drafts` beside `savesApps`. Its `?state=draft` cells for a caller who may not read drafts now require the plain read's answer byte for byte, with the protocol never asked for the draft row.
  - The #20290 real-stack "may not save" control moved from a capability-less member to a Studio builder, who may read drafts but may not save.
  - Five pins drove a draft switch as a capability-less caller to measure the draft branch itself: cache bypass ×2, forwarding ×2, and the drafts view's `api` exemption. Each now reads as `studio.access`. The served-only pin also asserts that the member's `?preview=draft` list is the filtered one.
- **Package runs:**
  - `@objectstack/rest` full `vitest --project local` at `78c4bdfdc`: 211 files, 3831 passed, 2 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/runtime` full `vitest --project local` at `e2c5f126d` (runtime `src` is unchanged since `8bc02e48b`): 283 files, 4072 passed, 1 skipped.
  - Both `typecheck` scripts exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes all three new test files.
  - `test:repo`: rest 8/8, runtime 69/69.
  - Final targeted run at `78c4bdfdc`: rest 8 files, 580 passed; runtime 3 files, 130 passed.

**Ablations.** All four legs ran at `8bc02e48b` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` wrap mode, inside a script with its own `EXIT`/`INT`/`TERM` trap that restores both files from `HEAD` by absolute path. Predictions were written before each run. Each subject is reached through source: rest tests import `./rest-server.js`, and runtime's vitest aliases `@objectstack/rest` to `../rest/src`, so no `dist/` is involved.

| Leg | Mutation | Predicted red (rest / runtime) | Observed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A-rest | REST helper `return true;` (anchor 1→0, blob `99e5c3b059fc`→`b18e3688d418`) | 26 (new 15, census 1, #20156 census 10) / 2 | 26 / 2 |
| B-rest | REST helper `return false;` (blob →`6d02fff57404`) | 32 (new 7, census 1, #20156 census 19, #20290 5) / 3 | 32 / 3 |
| A-rt | runtime helper `return true;` (blob `14f515580af9`→`483b0036cb51`) | 0 / 6 | 0 / 6 |

Each restore was proven: both blobs equal `HEAD` (`99e5c3b059fc`, `14f515580af9`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates

At `78c4bdfdc`, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 91 families from merge base `670471718`. All 91 exit 0. `--ran` reports: 91 derived, 91 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Three gates first refused with exit 3 (NOT MEASURED: unbuilt `client-react` and the full package tree): `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt`. All three exit 0 after the named builds.
- `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` first exited 2 on a docblock citation of a card that no longer resolves. It is now cited by its commit (`2a29caa`) and exits 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **`/diff` still serves draft content to a member. Out of scope here by order; this PR does not gate it.** Measured at `8bc02e48b` on the real stack, as a member with no authoring capability, on a published app with a pending draft: `GET /meta/app/NAME/diff?from=0&to=2` answers 200, carrying the draft's label and a draft-only navigation entry. `sys_metadata_history` holds a full body for every draft save, and `/diff` reads versions without a state filter. A draft-only app answers 404 there, because `/diff` reads the current document first. `/history` answers 200 with events only, and no body text. Gating `/diff` would change ruling B's stored-version door for every member, including their view of published history, so it is reported to the seat rather than done here.
- **Texts this makes true, left unedited (read-only packages):**
  - `metadata-core/src/object-schema-fls.ts` (the D4 docblock: 「draft/preview reads are admin-gated upstream already」);
  - `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, where `getMetaItem`'s preview branch says 「(admin-gated upstream)」 and `getMetaItems`'s says 「admin-gated upstream — see http-dispatcher」;
  - the `2a29caa` changeset's 「draft access stays admin-gated upstream」.

  All three are now true of every door that takes a draft switch. Only `/diff` above still serves draft bodies without the gate.
- **A boundary of the ruled predicate, not a defect found:** a caller who holds only `manage_org_presentation` may save an org-scoped draft of an org-overridable type, but is not admitted to read drafts, as on `/meta/_drafts` before this PR. Their `?state=draft` now answers the published item. Measured holders: no default permission set, platform object or example grants `manage_org_presentation`. Whether an objectui editor reads `?state=draft` as such a caller is not measurable here: objectui is not in this container.
- **Observation, not filed:** `plugin-security`'s `probeUnpublishedDraft` changes a refusal's wording when an object exists only as a draft. That reveals existence, never content. It is by design (its docblock), and no card or change is proposed.
- `docs/ui/apps.mdx` gains one sentence stating who may read a pending app draft, and what anyone else is answered.
- Commit trailers are the model-free pair the dispatch order names.
